content: bollard 0.21.0 supports Podman as a first-class runtime. Verified on docs.rs/bollard/0.21.0 struct.Docker: connect_with_podman_defaults() exists alongside connect_with_local_defaults, connect_with_unix_defaults, connect_with_socket, connect_with_ssh, connect_with_http. Podman probe order: DOCKER_HOST (unix:// only), XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/podman/podman.sock, /run/user/UID/podman/podman.sock, /run/podman/podman.sock, then /var/run/docker.sock. Bollard generated from moby 1.52 schema; use negotiate_version() with Podman since its compat endpoint reports a lower API version. One client therefore covers docker AND podman. crates.io: 42.2M total / 13.2M recent downloads, updated 2026-05-04, keywords container/docker/podman.
